top_signals.title: Reliance Drives India’s Venezuelan Oil Imports to Seven-Year High
top_signals.summary: Reliance Industries is leading a major rebound in Indian crude oil imports from Venezuela, with more than three-quarters of all purchases from the South American country going to India’s biggest private refiner.   Reliance Industries, owned by Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani, operates the world’s largest crude oil processing complex at Jamnagar, which has the capacity to process 1.4 million barrels per day (bpd) of crude oil.  Following years of abstention from Venezuelan crude while U.S. sanctions were in place, Reliance…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: RBC’s Decade of Growth Puts It in Goldman’s Market-Value League
top_signals.summary: Royal Bank of Canada has climbed into the same market-value tier as Goldman Sachs Group Inc. and is worth more than Wells Fargo & Co. and Citigroup Inc., underscoring how a decade of expansion at home and abroad has pushed the Canadian lender into the upper ranks of North America’s most valuable banks.

top_signals.summary: The co-creator of Empire Market, one of the largest dark web marketplaces before its shutdown, has been sentenced to 40 years in prison for facilitating $430 million in illegal transactions from 2018 to 2020. [...]
